title: 1 Nov-Diwali Sundowner-Eve of Fellowship & Giving
summary: The Diwali Sundowner on 1st November at the rooftop of Raheja Imperia, Lower Parel, was an evening of festive cheer, fellowship, delicious food, drinks and live music!
description:
The Diwali Sundowner on 1st November at the rooftop of Raheja Imperia, Lower Parel, was an evening of festive cheer, fellowship, delicious food, drinks and live music!

The highlight was our Charity Auction, featuring an eclectic collection of 16 wonderful treasures, from luxury hampers, fine art and jewellery to exclusive experiences and memorabilia. Conducted brilliantly by Rtn PP Hiten, the auction brought together generosity and philanthropy, raising an incredible ₹41 lakhs towards our club projects!

A heartfelt thank you to all the members, partners, contributors and dedicated teams whose efforts made the evening a grand success.

With 115 Members and 95 Partners in attendance, it was truly a celebration of friendship, fellowship and the spirit of giving.

This Diwali, we celebrated not just with lights, but by spreading happiness and making a difference. Every bid counted, every contribution mattered!
